campaign: r31 reproducibility recovery (the r26 master recipe was never recorded)
why: every committed report carries verdict=fail at top level; the r26 'green' was a Main-judge subset. Re-running with defaults gave gate1 right 15.9 mm (vs 0.000 recorded) - the env recipe was missing from the repo.

recipe.command: W6B_SCENE=ur5e W6B_SCENE_XML=grounding/assets/allegro_floating_ur5e_r24_vise.xml W6B_R23_FLYOVER_MM=250 W6B_R22_MARGIN_MM=8 W6B_R18_NATIVE_TARGET=1 W6B_R26_TRACK_A=1 runs/.venv-retarget/bin/python retarget/retarget_dual.py
recipe.search: 7 binary flags x 128 combinations, 7 s per run; 8 combinations tie at the minimum - R18_NATIVE_TARGET and R26_TRACK_A are the two that matter

side_mount_status.native_target_mode: ceiling-geometry bound: with R18_NATIVE_TARGET=1 the side mount degrades to 1044/367 mm - the native path is a fixed pendown that assumes the ceiling base

default_mode_base_sweep.note: rz=0 (identity) beats the horizontal side mount: the sideways base rotates the wrist away from the target orientation

gap: the r26 numbers are reproducible only with this recipe; it must be cited by any future claim that quotes them
